She may look like a regular girl, but she’s certainly strange and unusual! Sideshow, in partnership with Warner Bros. Discovery Global Consumer Products (WBDGCP), presents the Lydia Deetz Sixth Scale Figure. This new articulated, fully costumed figure is jumping into our line of Beetlejuice collectibles inspired by the 1988 horror comedy classic.

The Lydia Deetz Sixth Scale Figure captures the teen icon of ’80s cinema in all her gloomy glory. This articulated figure features a Phicen jointed body and a carefully tailored fabric costume complete with sculpted accessories to recreate fan-favorite moments from the film. Lydia’s all-black ensemble comes with a removable wide-brimmed hat for keeping the sun off her pale complexion and signature spiked bangs.

Thankfully, a house full of ghosts, snakes, and creepy cocktail shrimp can’t make this shutterbug shudder — Lydia has a point-and-shoot camera with strap as well as an insta-camera with an instant picture of the Maitlands as sheet ghosts … no feet. She also has a pen and papers to recreate her dramatic farewell note to her family. Six hands are included for interacting with her accessories and creating memorable poses; one hand for holding her pen, one hand for holding either camera, a pair of fists, and a pair of open hands. Display Lydia and all her unique deets on the provided black hexagonal figure base.

The Lydia Deetz Sixth Scale Figure includes:
- Headsculpt of Winona Ryder, as seen in Beetlejuice
- Tailored Costume, including:
- Removable wide-brimmed hat
- All-black ensemble
- Boots
- Six (6) total hands
- Point-and-shoot camera with strap
- Instant camera
- Picture of the Maitlands as sheet ghosts
- Pen and papers
- Black hexagon base

Product Size
Height: 25 cm

nome_articolo: Bandai Dragon Ball Daima Super Saiyan 4 Son Goku S.h.figuarts (Action Figure)
descrizione:
Enter the world of Dragon Ball DAIMA with the legendary S.H.Figuarts Super Saiyan 4 Son Goku!

This premium figure faithfully reproduces Goku's new SSJ4 form, thanks to a completely redesigned sculpt and the latest articulation technologies developed by Bandai. The high level of detail particularly highlights the character's distinctive fur and iconic hairstyle.
The set includes four interchangeable facial expressions, allowing for various display options, as well as a Kamehameha effect for dynamic and impactful poses.
As a special bonus, the Magic Staff (Nyoi-bo) and an additional facepiece compatible with other figures from the S.H.Figuarts Dragon Ball line are also included.
A must-have for collectors and an excellent business opportunity for retailers specializing in anime merchandise and action figures.

descrizione:

nome_articolo: Factory Entertainment Battlestar Galactica Cubits & Pyramid Set Limited Edition Prop (Replica)
descrizione:

12 metal cubits (6 "G" and 6 "L")
Complete 52-card deck
